description: Test suite for configuration issue formatting functions, including normalization and formatting of issue lines and metadata.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssuePath
methods.description: Normalizes a given path string, replacing null, undefined, or empty strings with '<root>'.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLine
methods.description: Formats a single configuration issue line with optional marker and normalization.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLines
methods.description: Formats multiple configuration issue lines, optionally normalizing root paths.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssue
methods.description: Normalizes configuration issue metadata for machine output by removing hidden allowed values if count exceeds zero.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssues
methods.description: Normalizes an array of configuration issues.
